title: Code application to new construction within an existing building
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: The project alters the basement of one side of an existing duplex, reconfiguring rooms and adding a room, changing stairs and interior wall finishes, and including structural modifications, framing and finishing.

The local authority required current-code treatment for several matters including exterior-wall and joist-space insulation, vapour barrier, interconnected smoke/CO detectors and bathroom exhaust; the appellant said the work would not reduce existing performance.
The cited existing-building provision is Sentence 1.1.1.2.(1) of Division A.
